name: complete-helper-consumers
goal: Count actual named-function callers in every registered source kind, including templates, workflows, config and route functions, before deciding whether a helper is private.

evidence: A helper used by a named template, config or route function has an actual function consumer regardless of the registered module kind.
The standard consumer matrix covered components/services and conventional function modules but omitted named functions in template/config/route units. Two reusable matrix rows expose the omission.
